title: a container whose children carry the work
body: An epic: the panel under it groups its children by type.

title: a typed child of that container
body: The child the container's panel shows.

title: an untyped child of that container
body: The child the container's panel does not show at all.

title: an ordinary issue that happens to have a child
body: Not a container, so the child's type is nobody's rule here.

title: an untyped child of an ordinary issue
body: Out of the container rule's scope.
